messages:
Samira (CEO): starting a short follow-up thread for questions from today's all-hands on mission/positioning. keep it tight and actionable.
Noah - Head of Product: we heard questions about whether to lead with 'performance' or 'cost'. preference?
Samira (CEO): lead with performance (latency/SLOs) + reliability, then call out cost controls as the business benefit.
Eli (Eng): practical ask: should Engineering treat 'portable configs' as GA? some docs still say 'experimental'.
Noah - Head of Product: make portability GA in docs this quarter. owners: Eng + Docs to sync on naming and examples.
Priya (Sales): competitor angle: prospects ask "why not cloud provider endpoints" early. short script for SDRs?
Juno (Marketing): try: "Cloud endpoints give access to models; we make them reliable, observable, and economical at scale." hand to AE with benchmark link.
Kai (Infra): ops question: customers want a clear list of fallback effects (what breaks when we downgrade). should that be public?
Samira (CEO): yes, publish a degradation matrix. transparency reduces surprise and speeds sales cycles.
Priya (Sales): asks for a private battlecard vs major cloud providers for discovery calls.
Samira (CEO): approved. Marketing + Sales to produce a privacy-labeled battlecard. due EOW.
ops-bot: task-created: "publish portability GA + degradation matrix + battlecard" assigned to Noah/Priya/Juno; due 2026-04-07.
Samira (CEO): thanks everyone. we'll post final assets in #marketing-ops and link back here. short follow-ups only please.
